payload.claim: `_draft_candidate` computes `spec_sha=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()` by hand, and `_draft` (line 1240) does the same for the item's bytes, instead of importing `hash_artifact` from `saffron/agents/artifacts.py` (`def hash_artifact(raw: str) -> str: return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest()`), which `saffron/spec_review.py:623` already uses for this exact purpose (`spec_sha=hash_artifact(text) if text else None`). This is a helper the repository already defines being restated rather than imported ('One source'): if `hash_artifact` ever changes (e.g. normalization before hashing), `cli.py`'s two inline copies silently diverge from every other spec_sha in the system.
